name: Expedition into the Sunken Necropolis: Journey to the Ruined Ancient City

cycle_advancement.world_state: Archeotech Expedition Dispatched to Ancient City (0,0)

locations_modified.ambient_tension: The forward expedition crosses the monumental basalt archway of the Sunken Necropolis. Ancient emerald sensor eyes hum to life high above in the cyclopean ruins, casting long shadows across forgotten cogitator vaults.
Confessor Malachi maintains holy prayer vigils at the northern gate as the expedition departs into the forgotten ruins beneath Saint Katherine's crypts.

completed_milestones.title: Archeotech Expedition into the Sunken Necropolis Launched
completed_milestones.consequence: Sergeant Kathryn Vane led a hand-picked strike team (Bragg, Jax, and 4 veteran riflemen) with 4 days of field rations, entering the ancient ruined city at (0,0) to recover forgotten archeotech and secure survival.

active_disasters_and_trials.name: The Silent Crypts of the First Hive
active_disasters_and_trials.threat: The ancient city is sealed behind millennia-old logic gates, localized gravity anomalies, and dormant defense automata.
active_disasters_and_trials.human_trial: Navigate the forgotten corridors, avoid triggering defense grid arrays, and locate archeotech energy generators before field rations expire.

new_decision.decision: Realizing the sub-level cannot endure prolonged attrition from future underhive waves, led Bone 'ead Bragg, Trooper Jax, and 4 veteran riflemen through the sunken catacombs beneath Saint Katherine's Basilica into the ancient ruined city at (0,0), carrying 4 days of supplies to seek archeotech power generators and lost Imperial weapon vaults.
new_decision.impact: Established forward staging camp in the Sunken Necropolis; located sealed pre-Imperial datavaults and initiated breach assessment.

new_decision.decision: Marched at the point of the expedition carrying the heavy field supply crate and a spare krak charge, eyes scanning the towering dark ruins for ancient traps.
new_decision.impact: Shielded the expedition party as they entered the cyclopean necropolis gates; vitality restored to 70.

new_decision.decision: Rallied 4 veteran conscripts, fitted with grade-3 respirators, and moved ahead to mark safe footing across the crumbling ancient plasteel bridges.
new_decision.impact: Discovered an unlooted pre-Heresy maintenance conduit leading into the central cogitator spire; vitality recovered to 55.
